text: Of David. A Maskil. 1 Blessed [is he] with transgression lifted, with sin is covered.
Blessed [is] the man for whom YHWH does not reckon iniquity, and in his spirit [is] no deceit.
When I remained silent, my bones were worn out by my groaning all the day.
For day and night Your hand was heavy upon me; my juice was overturned, [as] in the drought of summer. Selah
I made known to You my sin, and my iniquity I did not hide; I said, “I will make confession over my transgressions to YHWH,” and You forgave the guilt of my sin. Selah
upon thus, let every godly one pray to You, in a time to find; even with a flood of great waters toward him, they shall not touch him.
You [are] a hiding [place] unto me; from distress you keep me; with shouts of deliverance, You will surround me. Selah
I will instruct you and direct you in the way that you should go; [with] My eye I will give counsel concerning you.
You⁺ should not be like a horse, like a mule without understanding, with bit and bridle to curb its ornaments, [that] there is no coming near to you.
Many [are] the pains of the wicked, and the one trusting in YHWH, loving devotion shall surround him.
Be glad in YHWH and rejoice, O righteous ones, and shout for joy, all upright of heart!
